args: go2rtc --version     && pip3 install --no-cache-dir "uv==$(awk -F'==' '/^uv==/{print $2}' homeassistant/requirements.txt)"     && uv pip install         --no-build         -r homeassistant/requirements.txt

if ls homeassistant/home_assistant_*.whl 1> /dev/null 2>&1; then         uv pip install homeassistant/home_assistant_*.whl;     fi     && uv pip install         --no-build         -r homeassistant/requirements_all.txt
uv pip install         -e ./homeassistant     && python3 -m compileall         homeassistant/homeassistant

organization.description: Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first. Powered by a worldwide community of tinkerers and DIY enthusiasts.

release.body:
- Split Matter TemperatureOffset range by Thermostat ClusterRevision ([@lboue] - [#180517]) ([matter docs])
- Bump pywaze to 1.2.4 ([@eifinger] - [#184663]) ([waze_travel_time docs]) (dependency)
- Bump pyicloud to 2.7.0 ([@FezVrasta] - [#184728]) ([icloud docs]) (dependency)
- Retry failed Analytics insights refresh ([@chemelli74] - [#184731]) ([analytics_insights docs])
- Fix WLED color modes not following a changed LED setup ([@frenck] - [#184778]) ([wled docs])
- Bump dwdwfsapi to 1.1.0 ([@frenck] - [#184784]) ([dwd_weather_warnings docs]) (dependency)
- Add description for the device selection field in the Qingping config… ([@tengfeili-qingping] - [#184797]) ([qingping docs])
- Send a result for the ZHA reconfigure websocket subscription ([@frenck] - [#184812]) ([zha docs])
- Bump solaredge-web to 0.5.0 ([@tronikos] - [#184821]) ([solaredge docs]) (dependency)
- Keep a missing meter history from blocking Peblar setup ([@frenck] - [#184824]) ([peblar docs])
- Fix `KeyError` in the Airly integration when the API payload contain no sensor data ([@bieniu] - [#184828]) ([airly docs])
- Restore unverified TLS for stream sources and add a verify_ssl option ([@RaHehl] - [#184877]) ([stream docs])
- Fix FRITZ!SmartHome SSDP discovery with hostname presentation URL ([@mib1185] - [#184896]) ([fritzbox docs])
- Only create Bosch SHC child lock switch when ChildProtection exists ([@mosandlt] - [#184908]) ([bosch_shc docs])
- Skip TLS verification for UniFi Protect RTSPS streams ([@RaHehl] - [#184930]) ([unifiprotect docs])
- Return same images as you see on the immich server, even the edited ones ([@mib1185] - [#184955]) ([immich docs])
- Don't report 0 for missing FRITZ!SmartHome powermeter values ([@mib1185] - [#184968]) ([fritzbox docs])
- Reload Immich integration when the server version changes ([@mib1185] - [#184978]) ([immich docs])
- Set state to unknown in Husqvarna Automower error sensor, when error is unknown ([@Thomas55555] - [#185087]) ([husqvarna_automower docs])
- Seed deCONZ group color modes from unreachable lights too ([@marcus13371337] - [#185117]) ([deconz docs])
- Bump ZHA to 2.3.1 ([@TheJulianJES] - [#185156]) ([zha docs]) (dependency)
- Fix storing traces for automations without an ID ([@Kevin-Tamayose] - [#185161]) ([automation docs]) ([trace docs])
- Tag TTS audio carrying an empty ID3 tag ([@tronikos] - [#185193]) ([tts docs])
- Fix Tradfri color bulbs losing HS color mode ([@frenck] - [#185197]) ([tradfri docs])
- Fix false shell template repair for static command_line commands ([@frenck] - [#185203]) ([command_line docs])
- Constrain graphql-core below 3.3 ([@frenck] - [#185206]) (dependency)
- Do not link a trace that is not stored as a child ([@Xyolyp] - [#185207]) ([trace docs])
- Fix Hue light crash when the bridge reports no color temperature ([@frenck] - [#185218]) ([hue docs])
- Fix generic thermostat rechecking too late after a minimum cycle or cooldown ([@frenck] - [#185221]) ([generic_thermostat docs])
- Fix Signal Messenger notify failing to load when the REST API is down at startup ([@frenck] - [#185225]) ([signal_messenger docs])
- Don't create Nibe number entities for date coils ([@frenck] - [#185229]) ([nibe_heatpump docs])
- Round LG Infrared target temperature instead of truncating it ([@frenck] - [#185231]) ([lg_infrared docs])
- Log in to OmniLogic again after a failed update ([@frenck] - [#185250]) ([omnilogic docs])
- Remember silent SolarEdge Modbus blocks across setups ([@tronikos] - [#185255]) ([solaredge_modbus docs])
- Update frontend to 20260930.3 ([@bramkragten] - [#185285]) ([frontend docs]) (dependency)
- Bump wled to 1.1.1 ([@frenck] - [#185344]) ([wled docs]) (dependency)
- Keep deprecated device config entry attributes working in templates ([@frenck] - [#185361])
- Bump modbus-connection to 4.12.4 ([@balloob] - [#185419]) ([modbus docs]) (dependency)
- Fix WLED adding Wi-Fi sensors to wired devices ([@frenck] - [#185425]) ([wled docs])
- Add new error codes to Husqvarna Automower ([@Thomas55555] - [#185477]) ([husqvarna_automower docs])
- Fix Arve availability on failed updates ([@erwindouna] - [#185494]) ([arve docs])
- Fix EZVIZ availability on failed updates ([@erwindouna] - [#185497]) ([ezviz docs])
- Fix 17TRACK availability on failed updates ([@erwindouna] - [#185501]) ([seventeentrack docs])
- Fix Starlink availability on failed updates ([@erwindouna] - [#185502]) ([starlink docs])
- Fix Subaru availability on failed updates ([@erwindouna] - [#185503]) ([subaru docs])
- Fix SUPLA availability on failed updates ([@erwindouna] - [#185504]) ([supla docs])
- Fix TOLO availability on failed updates ([@erwindouna] - [#185505]) ([tolo docs])
- Fix Xbox availability on failed updates ([@erwindouna] - [#185506]) ([xbox docs])
- Fix Yardian availability on failed updates ([@erwindouna] - [#185507]) ([yardian docs])
- Give SolarEdge Modbus reads a 30 s timeout ([@tronikos] - [#185518]) ([solaredge_modbus docs])
- Fix typo in Husqvarna Automower ([@Thomas55555] - [#185532]) ([husqvarna_automower docs])
- Revert "Resolve integration brand images before brand images" ([@joostlek] - [#185535]) ([brands docs])
- Allow dynamic ports for registered loopback OAuth redirects ([@balloobbot] - [#185544]) ([auth docs])
- Fix Matter get_lock_users stopping on a null nextUserIndex ([@raman325] - [#182808]) ([matter docs])
- Bump pyElectra to 1.2.5 in electrasmart ([@noamokman] - [#184187]) ([electrasmart docs]) (dependency)
- Bump python-kasa to 0.11.0.1 ([@rytilahti] - [#184235]) ([tplink docs]) (dependency)
- Remove user-configurable polling interval from `omnilogic` ([@tr4nt0r] - [#184380]) ([omnilogic docs]) (breaking-change)
- Fix Spotify coordinator crash when playing without an item ([@kleinc80] - [#184723]) ([spotify docs])
- Bump aioautomower to 3.1.0 ([@Thomas55555] - [#184970]) ([husqvarna_automower docs]) (dependency)
- Don't toggle the OpenEVSE manual override when it is already in the requested state ([@frenck] - [#185257]) ([openevse docs])
- Retry ViCare setup on transient API errors ([@lackas] - [#185534]) ([vicare docs])
- Show app name in MCP discovery flow title ([@balloob] - [#185541]) ([mcp docs])
- Ensure IMAP actions always close TCP stream ([@robin-thoni] - [#185547]) ([imap docs])
- Bump tplink-omada-client to 1.5.13 ([@rubempoli] - [#185585]) ([tplink_omada docs]) (dependency)
- Report an uncalibrated Shelly RPC cover by its last direction ([@thecode] - [#185624]) ([shelly docs])
- Bump reolink_aio to 0.21.18 ([@starkillerOG] - [#185631]) ([reolink docs]) (dependency)
- Preserve fractional transition times for TRÅDFRI lights ([@addibbi] - [#185633]) ([tradfri docs])
- Bump tailscale to 1.0.0 ([@frenck] - [#185639]) ([tailscale docs]) (dependency)
- Patch the PyViCare client instead of integration setup in ViCare tests ([@lackas] - [#184730]) ([vicare docs])
